title: Uv Editor Improvements | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our UV Editor in CLO 2025.0 allows you to access UV Editor without switching modes, and the side and back UVs can be edited. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio
